evidence.note: Historical app learning and real-card research identified H1-QHD-INFINITE V0.5.9 and front-only 1CH recording. These observations do not validate current retail firmware or every advertised feature.

notes: Configuration and logs are excluded from normal video import.

technical_facts.label: Exact safe model marker
technical_facts.value: H1-QHD-INFINITE in CONFIG/config.bin; historical observed firmware V0.5.9.

technical_facts.label: Historical channel evidence
technical_facts.value: 1CH in the boot log; observed filenames omit the S1 F/I/R physical channel tokens. N maps to front in the sampled H1 profile.

technical_facts.label: Historical media summary
technical_facts.value: Research notes report driving and parking MP4 samples as H.264, 2560x1440, 30 fps, approximately 22 Mbps. No per-file numeric measurements were retained in the archived reference profile.

sources.label: Vueroid H1 historical card research notes
Official H1 QHD Infinite product page

notes: Public visibility is authorized by the owner's release confirmation. The official product page styles the camera H1 QHD Infinite; the stable profile ID remains vueroid-h1.

The historical config and log evidence confirms parking recording but does not name the exact parking mode. PARK and PEVENT are observed folder categories, not proof of a particular motion, time-lapse, or power-saving setting.
Historical V0.5.9 observations are not a current retail specification or bitrate guarantee. No S1 measurements or additional channel capabilities are transferred to H1.
